# December without a perfect schedule

Mum wants an ordinary Christmas lunch, not a conference about next year's care arrangements. We agreed to discuss the medication change next week. The reminder can wait. [[Care arrangements]] should support a life without becoming the subject of every visit. Took her a bowl from class; she noticed the awkward handle and asked for the other mug.
